caption:
Stop hiding one coupon behind 24 doors. Nobody plays that. Save this before you plan your Christmas campaign.

Most advent calendar campaigns put the same discount behind every door. That's a coupon with extra steps, and customers can tell.

A game designer would add 3 things:

1. A streak: open 5 days in a row, unlock something bigger
2. A surprise you can't predict
3. A reason to share: a team score beats a lonely coupon

Same budget. Better customer engagement, and better reasons to come back.
